description.value: Dalina is a Vancouver café and catering business founded in 2016, with this location in the Chinatown/Mount Pleasant neighbourhood serving daily from-scratch brunch and specialty coffee roasted by nearby Pallet Coffee Roasters. The café has an outdoor patio with heat warmers and operates as both a dine-in spot and a kitchen offering takeout and online corporate catering delivery across Vancouver. A rewards and loyalty program is available across all ordering channels.
